toegepas.rede_vinder: The edge of a city is its 'rand' (stadsrand); 'rant' usually means a ridge, so 'rante' can be read as hills.
toegepas.fout: 'rante' normally means ridges, so a city growing 'aan sy rante' can be misread as growing on its hills rather than at its edges.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'rande' is the standard word for a city's edges (stadsrand), removes the ambiguity, and touches no protected wording or meaning.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Die naaste hospitaal of kollege is ook dikwels ver.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Die naaste hospitaal of kollege is ook dikwels ver weg.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: A bare predicative 'ver' at sentence end is stiff; 'ver weg' is the natural form.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Predicative 'ver' at the end of the sentence is ordinary, natural Afrikaans, so 'ver weg' is only a lateral move.
